mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.problem: Learn how small deals work and get the search toolkit: a paid searcher community or accelerator (Acquisition Lab lifetime membership; Searchfunder sells monthly, annual and lifetime plans)
mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.note: Seen as 'The Lab offers a lifetime membership for $10,000'. Searchfunder's own plan prices were not shown in results. Common first spend; many searchers buy one or the other.

mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.problem: Finance the purchase: the SBA 7(a) upfront guaranty fee and lender closing costs the buyer carries
mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.price_text: On a $1M+ acquisition loan, expect to pay $25,000-$35,000 in guarantee fees
mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.note: Replaces the old 'equity injection' step, which is capital, not a fee paid to solve a problem. The same page says the fee adds 2-3.5% at closing and is usually financed into the loan.

mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.problem: Value the target for the lender: an independent, SBA-format business valuation
mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.note: Reused from the current ladder. Lenders require it on most SBA acquisition loans, so nearly every buyer pays.

mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.problem: Check the seller's numbers before signing: a quality of earnings report
mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.note: Reused from the current ladder. Standard buyer diligence spend on deals of this size.

mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.problem: Close the deal: an attorney for legal diligence, the purchase agreement and closing documents
mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.note: This figure is the limited-scope initial engagement that DueDilio describes; the same search pass showed full-deal fixed fees 'from $20,000' in a blended summary without a clear source page. Replaces the old $1,290 template price, which was a document template, not a lawyer. The old 'broker commission' step is dropped: the seller pays the broker.

mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.problem: Run it after closing: outsourced bookkeeping and monthly accounts for the business
mid-career-searchers-buying-small-busine.note: Replaces the old fractional CFO step: the searcher is the CFO, but almost all pay a bookkeeper or CPA. The old 'AI voice agent' step is dropped as not a common paid problem for this room.

iim-isb-first-years-finance-consulting-p.problem: Practise case interviews with peers and coaches before summer placement week (PrepLounge Premium, one year)
iim-isb-first-years-finance-consulting-p.note: Seen as a one-time payment for one year. Premium + Coaching packages start at USD $199 on the same site. Consulting is the largest recruiter at these schools, and paid case practice is common.

iim-isb-first-years-finance-consulting-p.problem: Learn valuation, financial modelling and finance interview technicals for bank and PE profiles (instructor-led course, India)
iim-isb-first-years-finance-consulting-p.note: Seen as the training fee for The WallStreet School's Financial Modelling and Valuations course; a self-paced version was listed at Rs. 24,000 plus GST. Folds the old separate 'interview guide' step into one problem: pass the finance interviews.

iim-isb-first-years-finance-consulting-p.problem: Signal finance intent with the CFA Level I registration (early registration, 2026)
iim-isb-first-years-finance-consulting-p.note: Reused from the current ladder; a 2026 result confirmed USD 1,140 early and USD 1,490 standard, with the old enrolment fee removed. Common among students targeting finance roles. The old fee and education-loan steps are dropped: they are paid before joining and belong to the admits room. The old 'if placements miss' programme is dropped as an edge case at these schools.

first-finance-hires-funded-startups.problem: Fix the books: outsourced bookkeeping and monthly close for a funded startup (Pilot, priced by monthly expenses)
first-finance-hires-funded-startups.note: Seen as 'Pilot starts at $599/mo for businesses with expenses up to $30,000'. Almost every seed-to-Series-B startup pays a bookkeeping firm before or as the first finance hire arrives.

first-finance-hires-funded-startups.problem: Manage the cap table and get a 409A valuation for option grants (Carta paid plan or a standalone 409A)
first-finance-hires-funded-startups.note: Kept without a price: results showed Carta's Starter plan 'at $2,800 per year' with 409A included and standalone 409A 'roughly $2,000 to $5,000 per valuation', but in a blended summary spanning spendflo.com, justpricing.com and vcbeast.com, so no single source URL could be named. Funded US startups must do this to grant options.

first-finance-hires-funded-startups.problem: Set up the model, budget and board reporting in an FP&A tool instead of spreadsheets (Runway, early-stage contracts)
first-finance-hires-funded-startups.note: Seen for early-stage and Series A teams. Board-ready monthly packages are what investors expect from this hire, and a planning tool is a common purchase in year one.

first-finance-hires-funded-startups.problem: File the annual corporate tax return and claim the R&D payroll tax credit (US example)
first-finance-hires-funded-startups.price_text: fixed fee of 15% of the anticipated captured credit amount with a minimum fee of $1,000
first-finance-hires-funded-startups.note: Seen as one firm's R&D credit study fee; other results put a study at $4,000–$6,000. Annual and recurring for every venture-backed US startup.

first-finance-hires-funded-startups.problem: Hire the first analyst or accountant through a contingency recruiter
first-finance-hires-funded-startups.price_text: Standard contingency rates range from 15% to 25% of the hire's first-year salary, with 20% being the most common benchmark according to SHRM
first-finance-hires-funded-startups.note: Replaces the old 'new-manager training' step: startups more often pay a recruiter than send this hire on a course. The old pitch-deck, fractional-CFO benchmark, registered-agent, AI-voice-agent and modelling-refresher steps are dropped: they belong to founders or bankers, or are not common paid problems for this person.

valuation-analysts-pursuing-bv-credentia.problem: Complete the required training before the credential exam (US: NACVA CVA self-study training package; India: 50-hour RVO course at Rs. 20,000 to 25,000)
valuation-analysts-pursuing-bv-credentia.note: Reused from the current ladder. The old US and India alternatives are merged into one step; the India price (taxguru.in) is kept in this note rather than as a separate step.

valuation-analysts-pursuing-bv-credentia.problem: Sit the credential exam (NACVA CVA exam; India: IBBI valuation exam at Rs. 5,900 per attempt on the old ladder's source)
valuation-analysts-pursuing-bv-credentia.note: Reused from the current ladder; the old separate IBBI exam step is merged here.

valuation-analysts-pursuing-bv-credentia.problem: Apply for and register the designation
Buy the transaction data needed to do valuation work (DealStats annual subscription)
valuation-analysts-pursuing-bv-credentia.note: Seen as 'an annual subscription to DealStats currently costs $1,050 per year'. Replaces the old $725-per-month 'Ultimate' bundle, which is one vendor's top tier rather than the common spend. Comparable-transaction data is bought by nearly every practising valuer.

valuation-analysts-pursuing-bv-credentia.problem: Keep the credential: continuing education and the three-year recertification fee
valuation-analysts-pursuing-bv-credentia.note: Seen as 'NACVA will waive the entire $400 recertification fee for designees that complete at least 30 hours of NACVA courses', so the spend is either the fee or the courses. Replaces the old unpriced recertify step.

finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.problem: Set up the entity so clients can pay you (incorporation from anywhere; yearly registered agent follows)
finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.note: Reused from the current ladder. The old separate $100-per-year registered agent step is folded in here as ongoing cost of the same problem.

finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.problem: Insure the practice: professional liability (E&O) cover before signing the first client
finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.note: New step. Seen on a page written for people setting up a fractional CFO firm; clients and engagement letters commonly require it.

finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.problem: Join a practitioner community for pricing data, templates and referrals (Fractional Connections Accelerator level; the Inner Circle for fractional CFOs was seen at $49 for the first month)
finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.note: Reused from the current ladder; the Inner Circle's regular price was not shown in results.

finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.problem: Deliver client reporting without a team: a multi-client reporting and forecasting tool (Fathom or similar)
finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.note: Kept without a price: results showed Fathom 'starts at $65 per month for one entity on the Starter plan' and another listing at '$50 per month', in a blended summary spanning fathomhq.com, capterra.com and metapraxis.com, so no single source URL could be named. Fractional CFOs commonly pay for such a tool per client.

finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.problem: Win the first clients: paid outreach tooling (LinkedIn Sales Navigator Core)
finance-pros-starting-fractional-cfo-pra.note: New step replacing the old AI-search-visibility tool, which is not a common purchase. The old modelling-refresher and FPAC-credential steps are dropped: people with 6 to 15 years in finance rarely buy them at this point.

independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.problem: Source deals: a paid lower-middle-market deal network membership (Axial)
independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.price_text: from a few thousand dollars per month up to $8,000 or more
independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.note: New step. Seen as 'the service can range from a few thousand dollars per month up to $8,000 or more'; Axial does not publish pricing. Most sponsors pay for at least one sourcing platform.

independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.problem: Find the equity for each deal: the independent-sponsor conference circuit and forum memberships, or a placement agent
independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.note: Kept without a price: iGlobal Forum's Independent Sponsors Summit has a pricing page (events.iglobalforum.com/independent-sponsors-summit-pricing) but no figure appeared in results, and placement fees of about '2% for the capital that is raised' appeared only in a blended summary. Sponsors must raise equity deal by deal, and the conferences report 550+ paying attendees.

independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.problem: Check the seller's numbers before signing: a quality-of-earnings report
independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.price_text: $10,000 to $20,000 for a focused QoE Lite scope, and $25,000 to $50,000 for a full-scope engagement

independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.problem: Hold the investors' money: form and administer the deal SPV (formation, banking, investor onboarding, annual admin)
independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.note: Kept without a price: results showed 'SPV pricing ranges from $3,000 to $10,000+' and set-up fees of '$6,000 to $10,000' with '$2,000-$5,000' annual administration, in a blended summary spanning carta.com, polibit.io, allocations.com and spvhub.com, so no single source URL could be named. Every deal-by-deal raise needs a vehicle.

independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.problem: Close: buyer's counsel for the purchase agreement, financing documents and disclosure schedules
independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.note: Kept without a price: 'For mid-market deals, legal fees run $50K to $250K' appeared in a blended summary spanning sharevault.com, dealroom.net and mnacommunity.com, so no single source URL could be named. No deal closes without counsel.

independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.problem: After closing: the portfolio company's finance function (fractional CFO) and investor reporting
independent-sponsors-small-pe-firms.note: Reused from the current ladder. The old investor-deck, modelling-course and AI-voice-agent steps are dropped: sponsors write their own decks, the fund pays for any training, and the voice agent is not a common paid problem here.

laid-off-finance-professionals.problem: Review the severance agreement, garden leave and non-compete with an employment lawyer (flat-fee review)
laid-off-finance-professionals.note: Seen as the average flat fee for a severance agreement review; firm examples ran $700 to $1,000. Prices the old unpriced step 1.

laid-off-finance-professionals.problem: Rewrite the resume and the story for the new search (executive level)
Run the search: LinkedIn Premium Career for InMail and applicant insights
laid-off-finance-professionals.note: New step. Seen as the Premium Career price for new subscribers. A common purchase in the first weeks of a job search.

laid-off-finance-professionals.problem: Career coaching and interview practice by the hour
Pass the technical interview and the modelling test again (interview guide plus modelling course)
laid-off-finance-professionals.note: Reused; the old separate $199.99 interview-guide step is merged here because it is the same problem. The old visa-transfer step is dropped as a slice of the room rather than a common step.

laid-off-finance-professionals.problem: The reset route: GMAT for an MBA application (test centre)
laid-off-finance-professionals.note: Reused from the current ladder. The MBA is one of the three standard exits for laid-off analysts and associates.

new-pe-associates-first-year.problem: Before day one: a private equity and LBO modelling course so the first live model holds up without a VP checking it (BIWS bundle)
new-pe-associates-first-year.note: Reused from the current ladder. The old separate $499 Wall Street Prep refresher is merged here as the same problem.

new-pe-associates-first-year.problem: Year 2: decide on the MBA route and sit the GMAT (test centre)
Admissions consulting for a multi-school MBA application (comprehensive package)
new-pe-associates-first-year.price_text: $6,950 for 1 school, $8,950 for 2 schools, and $10,950 for 3 schools
new-pe-associates-first-year.note: Reused from the current ladder. The old live-deal and portfolio-reporting steps are dropped because nobody pays to solve them (learned on the job), and the new-manager training step is dropped because the fund, not the associate, pays for that. Three steps is the honest length for this room.
